title: Topic 9
japanese_text:
A：これからよろしくね。私じゃ<u>頼りない</u>かもしれないけど、サポートするから<u>何なりと</u>言ってね。
B：ありがとうございます！ Aさんがリーダーでとても<u>心強い</u>です。
english_translation: A: I'm looking forward to working with you. I hope you don't find me undependable, and I will try to support you, so please feel free to come to me with anything. B: Thank you very much! Mr. A, having you as our leader is very reassuring.
